user.title: Connect your Motorola account
user.description: Enter your Motorola Nursery email. We will request a six-digit sign-in code.

code.title: Confirm the email code
code.description: Enter the six-digit code sent by Motorola. No password is required.

devices.title: Load your cameras
devices.description: Login succeeded. Submit to retry loading the cameras without requesting another email code.

host.title: Connect to the camera
host.description: Enter the camera’s local IP address or hostname. Home Assistant will verify the local connection.

menu_options.user: Connect or sign in to the Motorola account

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the camera. Check its address, power and network.
error.cannot_connect_cloud: Unable to reach Motorola. Try again.
error.invalid_code: The code is invalid or expired.
error.code_request_failed: Motorola did not accept the code request. Wait before trying again.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without a URL or port.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already configured. Use Reconfigure on its existing entry.
abort.code_expired: The login attempt expired. Start again to request a new code.
abort.login_connection_lost: The login connection or session expired. Start again to request a new code.
abort.wrong_account: The current camera was not found in this account. The existing configuration was preserved.
abort.no_devices: No supported cameras were found in this account.
